# Rate limiting
> capability: ratelimit | key: RL | updated: 2026-10-20

## Purpose
How many requests a client may make, and how quickly its allowance comes back.

## Requirements

### Requirement: RL-R1 Take tokens
When a client makes a request costing some tokens, the system SHALL allow it only if the client's bucket holds enough tokens, and SHALL then remove those tokens.

#### Scenario: RL-R1.S1 Enough tokens
- GIVEN a bucket holding 5 tokens
- WHEN a request costing 3 tokens arrives
- THEN the request is allowed
- AND the bucket holds 2 tokens

#### Scenario: RL-R1.S2 Not enough tokens
- GIVEN a bucket holding 1 token
- WHEN a request costing 3 tokens arrives
- THEN the request is refused
- AND the bucket still holds 1 token

### Requirement: RL-R2 Refill over time
While time passes, the system SHALL add tokens to each bucket at its rate, never above its capacity.

#### Scenario: RL-R2.S1 Refill stops at capacity
- GIVEN a bucket of capacity 10 holding 9 tokens and a rate of 1 token per second
- WHEN 5 seconds pass
- THEN the bucket holds 10 tokens
